_note: These two MoJ-hosted Arabic PDFs have a BROKEN font ToUnicode map: PyMuPDF text extraction yields ~9% replacement chars (U+FFFD) plus stray glyph mis-maps (e.g. ص→8, س→6, hamza→�). NOT recoverable via text extraction or simple substitution. Ingested then REMOVED from unified_embeddings to keep the dataset clean.
_recovery_status_2026_06_29: DEFERRED — both recovery paths hit walls. (1) OCR: easyocr/Tesseract OCR is the reliable fix, but easyocr pulls torch + scipy/opencv that REQUIRE numpy>=2, which conflicts with this project's deliberately-pinned numpy<2 (pandas==2.1.3 / pgvector); installing it in the main venv broke pandas, so it was uninstalled and the venv restored. Doing OCR needs an ISOLATED venv (.venv-ocr pattern, like mcp_server) running easyocr lang=['ar'] on fitz.get_pixmap page rasters; CPU OCR of ~500 pages (Penal 143pp + Commercial 358pp) is slow but works. (2) Clean re-source from uaelegislation.gov.ae: reachable via Playwright at PAGE level (HTTP 200, not blocked) but plain httpx 403s (Cloudflare) and its SPA search loads results via XHR that resisted quick scraping; the canonical /{ar}/legislations/{id}/download needs the legislation id (find via the SPA or a known-id list) then fetch through the Playwright browser context. Either path is viable but high-effort for 2 laws.
